The bug: no trimming, and no error handling (String.to_integer raises ArgumentError on garbage, and accepts trailing? Actually String.to_integer("4a") raises ArgumentError). Also "42" works. So fix: trim then match with Integer.parse and check rest is "".

Minimal change: 

def parse(string) do
  case Integer.parse(String.trim(string)) do
    {int, ""} -> int
    _ -> :error
  end
end

Note Integer.parse handles "+" prefix too? Integer.parse("+7") => {7, ""}. Fine.

Also note String.to_integer with base default 10. Also strings with unicode? fine.
